subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should OpenClaw silently discard errors from unconfigured providers, or should it surface a generic user-facing failure when an unexpected provider path is reached?
rationale: The formatter parser gap has a narrow code fix, but silent discard affects provider routing, debugging, and channel delivery policy and cannot be inferred safely from current source alone.

options.title: Generic user error plus internal observation
options.body: Keep user chat free of raw provider JSON while recording structured internal diagnostics for unexpected provider failures.

options.title: Silent discard for proven unconfigured providers
options.body: Drop the chat reply entirely only when the runtime can prove the failing provider was not configured by the user.

options.title: Formatter-only repair
options.body: Only parse top-level `detail` payloads and leave provider-origin routing behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Generic user error plus internal observation
recommendation.body: Keep user chat free of raw provider JSON while recording structured internal diagnostics for unexpected provider failures.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the most recent related merger and nearby error-safety contributor in the available history, while the decision spans formatter and provider/channel policy.
